en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4353 - It is narrated from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hariz, from al-Walid, who said that
"Whoever avoids marriage out of fear of poverty has thought poorly of Allah (swt), the Almighty and Glorious. Indeed, Allah (swt), the Almighty and Glorious, says:
'If they are poor, Allah (swt) will enrich them out of His bounty' (Surah An-Nur 24:32)."
